text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo got hurt, so we went to the
infirmary together. She looked like she was in a
lot of pain at first, but...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
W-Yay!
It doesn't hurt at all anymore!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo's gonna go hit the track!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Come on, Trainer!
Staying still is so boring~!
choice_data_list: I'm worried, so let's get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeh!! No, no, nooo!!
This is so boooring--!!
choice_data_list: I bought a fun game, want to challenge me?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Since it can't be helped, I'll do it for you!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We played games that put no strain on the body
and spent the time recuperating.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
Turbo Engine, igniting just a little bit!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... it hurts~... The Turbo Engine
has stalled out completelyyy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I frantically tended to Twin Turbo,
and it was decided she would need to rest for a while...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Look, look!
Turbo didn't lose to her injury!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo pushed through her injury with a smile
and made a smooth return afterward.
